name: Cosmological Perturbations & Large-Scale Structure
summary: Graduate cosmology: how tiny early fluctuations grew into the CMB anisotropies and the cosmic web, and how we measure them.

topics.name: Relativistic perturbation theory and gauge choices
Boltzmann equations for photons, baryons and dark matter

CMB temperature anisotropies and the angular power spectrum

Nonlinear structure: spherical collapse and the halo mass function
Weak gravitational lensing and cosmic shear
Cosmological parameter estimation and current tensions
